gamepad.navi.pointer.curve.label: Curve

gamepad.navi.pointer.scroll_accel.boost_.label: Full gas ×

gamepad.navi.pointer.scroll_accel.smooth.label: Smoothing ms

gamepad.navi.pointer.scroll_deadzone.description: Stick tilt below this fraction (0–1) is ignored for scrolling, so a resting stick does not scroll. Higher needs a bigger push to start.
